chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah asked Abā Ibrāhīm Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام about a man who misses the Witr prayer.
So he said: “He should make it up as Witr, always.”

key_terms.أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the kunyah of Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام
key_terms.الْوِتْرُ: the Witr prayer from the night prayer
key_terms.عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ: the narrator-questioner who asked the Imam
key_terms.يَفُوتُهُ: it escapes him or he misses it
key_terms.يَقْضِيهِ: he performs it as a make-up prayer

ai.seo_question: How should a missed Witr prayer be made up according to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about making up the missed Witr prayer. Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام states that when a person misses Witr, he should perform its qaḍāʾ as a single Witr prayer consistently.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1435 - Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah asked Abu Ibrahim Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a man who misses the Witr prayer.
Imam (as) said: "He should make it up as a single Witr always."
